TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd will deliver PITB’s District Case Management / workflow automation system using a controlled, ISO-aligned delivery lifecycle backed by our ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certifications [CO-PROFILE]. We will execute through four integrated workstreams: (1) discovery and process mapping, (2) solution configuration/build and security-by-design, (3) data migration and readiness, and (4) rollout, training, and three-year O&M.

Our methodology is proven on large, government-grade implementations combining application platforms and secure infrastructure, including Cloud Infrastructure for Federal Government (PKR 108M, completed 2025) [CAP-012], LMS Development for Provincial Government (PKR 102M, completed 2023) [CAP-046], and Mobile Banking for Provincial Government (PKR 121M, completed 2020) [CAP-023].

Technically, we will deliver a web-based system optimized for modern browsers, enforce role-based access control, and implement end-to-end information security controls under our ISO 27001-aligned practices [CO-PROFILE]. Our library does not yet evidence bilingual (English/Urdu) UI delivery or an RTO ≤ 4 hours DR implementation on prior CAP records; we will address this via early UX/prototyping with PITB sign-off for Urdu terminology and by designing and testing DR in the project’s first release cycle with documented failover drills and PITB-validated RTO measurements.

For migration, we will inventory existing registers/spreadsheets, define data standards, run iterative trial loads, and complete reconciliation with department focal persons before cutover. For adoption, we will conduct role-based training and handover. Post go-live, we will provide on-site support for 12 months and operate under PITB’s required SLA (including 99.5% uptime), leveraging our in-country support desk and established response SLAs [CO-PROFILE].

Mandatory staffing gap: our library does not yet evidence two CISSP (or equivalent) certified security professionals; we will fulfill this by onboarding/partnering certified resources prior to mobilization and submitting their credentials with the final team CV set.
